source.waller_definition: to float,to rise to surface,to come to mind

rows.mappingNote: New article under 浮かぶ explicitly recognizes source search-only 浮ぶ with the same reading.
rows.sourceNote: Teach physical floating, appearing and coming to mind; do not impose a strict state-versus-emergence partition against 浮く.

rows.mappingNote: New transitive ichidan article teaches setting afloat, showing an expression and bringing an image to mind.
rows.sourceNote: Distinguish grammatical transitivity from a claim that every expression is deliberate.

rows.mappingNote: New native godan article teaches humble hearing/being informed and accepting or undertaking a request.

rows.mappingNote: New noun article under 受け取り explicitly teaches source spelling 受取 and variant 受取り; includes receiving and document receipt.

rows.mappingNote: New transitive godan article teaches handling assigned work, a class or responsibility.

rows.mappingNote: New transitive ichidan article teaches dilution, lightening color and toning down an impression or effect.

rows.mappingNote: New noun/suru article under 打ち合わせ explicitly recognizes source 打合せ with the same reading.
rows.sourceNote: Teach advance coordination, not every promise, reservation, clothing overlap or archaic matching sense.

rows.sourceNote: Chinese-derived name history supports kango grouping, not fabricated modern constituent readings or a claim about the dish's complete ancestry.

externalDictionaryInspections.heading: 承る（読み）ウケタマワル
externalDictionaryInspections.dictionaryHeading: うけ‐たまわ・る‥たまはる【承】
externalDictionaryInspections.inspection: Actual fetched body supports humble receiving, hearing and accepting instructions. The Daijisen heading did not expose its definition body and is not the source of this receipt.
externalDictionaryInspections.limits: A previous search summary guessed the wrong numeric URL 440673. Only the actually fetched entry 439347 supports the claim. Author inspection is not independent reviewer retrieval.

externalDictionaryInspections.heading: 受取
externalDictionaryInspections.dictionaryHeading: うけ‐とり【受（け）取（り）／請（け）取（り）】
externalDictionaryInspections.inspection: Actual definition body: sense 1 receiving/collecting; sense 2, marked 受取, written acknowledgment of receiving money or goods, with 受取証/領収証. The card selects these, not the additional assigned-work or understanding senses.
externalDictionaryInspections.limits: The same mixed page has a separate 字通 reading じゆしゆ, not the taught native noun. Search-generated numeric URLs 443092, 436134 and 444478 were irrelevant, failed or unsupported; Weblio displayed no usable noun-definition body. Those are not evidence. Author inspection is not independent reviewer retrieval.

externalDictionaryInspections.heading: 異字同訓の漢字の使い分け例
externalDictionaryInspections.locator: Entry 025 うつす・うつる; PDF page 12, printed page 8
externalDictionaryInspections.dictionary: Agency for Cultural Affairs / Council for Cultural Affairs spelling guidance
externalDictionaryInspections.inspection: Actual PDF text inspected. 写す/写る concern exact copying, recording an image and showing through; 映す/映る concern reflection, projection, reproducing/displaying an image and impression. Footnote contrasts recording in ビデオに写る with reproduction in ビデオを映す, allows ビデオに映る姿 for playback and 映る for simultaneous live camera/display viewpoints.
externalDictionaryInspections.limits: Not an absolute photograph-versus-screen spelling boundary. PDF page 40 / printed page 35 contains older appendix examples, not measured present-day frequencies. Author PDF inspection is not independent reviewer retrieval.

externalDictionaryInspections.heading: うどん / 饂飩
externalDictionaryInspections.dictionary: Nipponica (日本大百科全書), encyclopedia body
externalDictionaryInspections.inspection: Actual encyclopedia body describes flour/salt-water noodles and Chinese-derived historical name development through うんどん/うどん. Supports the kango/background grouping, not an invented modern per-character reading or a complete claim about culinary ancestry. The linked 饂飩 entry 441039 was also inspected.
externalDictionaryInspections.limits: Daijisen heading on the page lacked a usable definition body. Unrelated Cambodian Udong and sculptor Houdon entries are excluded. Search prose guessed wrong numeric IDs; only inspected bodies count. Author retrieval is not independent reviewer retrieval.
